content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can deploy a minimum viable stack in the Philippines today using free infrastructure tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. This stack will allow you to accept international crypto payments through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Simply sign up for a NOWPayments account, generate your API keys, and integrate them into your Cloudflare Workers script. This will take less than an hour, and you'll be live in no time.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack that works for Filipino digital creators is a combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, integrated with NOWPayments. This stack provides a secure and reliable way to accept international crypto payments, and it's easy to deploy and maintain. With this stack, you can focus on creating and selling your digital products without worrying about payment processing.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

You don't need to worry about setting up a Stripe account or integrating with PayPal. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can skip the steps that don't matter and focus on what matters most - creating and selling your digital products. This means you can avoid the fees and restrictions associated with conventional payment platforms and keep 100% of your earnings.
You can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack in the Philippines in under an hour.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
